name: B10-0102/2025 (The Left) – Escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for Rwanda to pull its troops out of eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and to stop backing the M23 rebels. It wants the EU to stop importing minerals labelled as Rwandan until that happens. It also asks the EU to cancel its raw materials deal with Rwanda and halt military cooperation, including funding, until Rwanda respects Congo's sovereignty. It expresses solidarity with Congolese people and backs African-led peace efforts.

- The EU is asked to cancel its minerals deal with Rwanda and stop military funding.
- This affects Rwanda's government, EU companies buying minerals, and people in eastern Congo.
- Next, EU institutions decide whether to act on these requests; the resolution itself changes no law.
